description:
A Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three children has become the center of one of America’s most divisive trials. After five weeks of testimony, the jury reportedly split 11–1 over whether Lindsay Clancy should be held criminally responsible because of her mental state.
The result: a mistrial. We examine the evidence, the insanity defense, postpartum mental illness, and the culture war that has grown around the case.

title: 11 Jurors Said Not Guilty. One Holdout Forced a Mistrial.
